blocks.html: Heating and air-conditioning systems shall be provided with approved air filters. Filters shall be installed such that all return air, outdoor air and makeup air is filtered upstream from any heat exchanger or coil. Filters shall be installed in an accessible location. Liquid adhesive coatings used on filters shall have a flash point not lower than 325°F (162.8°C).
